concerns.text: FR-001 mandates downloading 'IMO/IPhO' datasets. T011 references a generic/unverified URL 'math-olympiad' and T012 loads 'ScienceQA' (OpenSci-Reason). The tasks fail to specify the canonical source for the IMO/IPhO dataset, violating the 'Verified Accuracy' principle and risking failure to acquire required data.

Spec Edge Cases require a fallback to 'a smaller quantized model or a distilled model' if the 8B model fails. T020 hardcodes a fallback to a 'distilled 3B model' only, omitting the 'smaller quantized' alternative. This is a semantic weakening of the flexible fallback requirement.

FR-009 requires a power analysis to 'justify' the sample size (implying the analysis determines sufficiency). T033 performs a verification on a 'fixed N=500' to check sufficiency. This narrows the scope to verification rather than justification, potentially ignoring if N=500 is insufficient.

Plan.md designates LME as the 'Mandatory Primary Test' and t-test/Point-Biserial as 'Descriptive'. Tasks T031/T032 implement t-test/Point-Biserial as primary tasks alongside LME (T030) without conditional logic or prioritization, risking wasted compute and violating the methodological hierarchy.

SC-005 requires measuring the 'sensitivity of the correlation coefficient to the exclusion of low-confidence prompts'. T034 handles data prep (exclusion) and T035 generates the report. No task explicitly implements the sensitivity analysis (re-calculating metrics with/without exclusions and comparing deltas), leaving the success criterion unmeasured.
